faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Find answers to common questions about our legal services.
faq.contact_prompt: Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.contact_desc: Contact our team directly to get answers to your specific questions.

1.q: What sets MRP Law Office apart from other law firms?
1.a: MRP Law Office has advantages including over {years} years of experience, a dedicated attorney team, a personalized approach for each client, and a strong international network. We don't just focus on legal aspects but also understand the business context of our clients to provide the most effective solutions.

2.q: How do I start a consultation with MRP Law Office?
2.a: You can contact us through the contact form on the website, email at info@mrplawoffice.com, or phone at (+62) 21 50300825. Our team will respond within 24 business hours to schedule an initial consultation session.

3.a: The initial consultation (30-60 minutes) at MRP Law Office is free and without obligation. This allows us to understand your needs and for you to evaluate whether we are the right legal partner.

4.q: What is the fee structure for legal services at MRP Law Office?
4.a: Our fee structure varies depending on the type and complexity of the case. We offer several models: hourly rate, flat fee for certain services, or retainer for ongoing legal needs. Fee transparency is our commitment — no hidden costs.

5.q: How long does it typically take to resolve a legal case?
5.a: The duration of case resolution depends greatly on the type and complexity of the case. Simple legal consultations can be resolved in hours, while court litigation can last several months to years. We always provide realistic time estimates at the beginning of case handling.

6.q: Does MRP Law Office handle international cases?
6.a: Yes, we have the experience and network to handle international legal cases, including international arbitration, cross-border contracts, and international trade disputes. We work with partner law firms in various countries.

7.q: How does MRP Law Office maintain client information confidentiality?
7.a: Client confidentiality is our top priority. All information you provide is protected by professional confidentiality obligations (attorney-client privilege) and our strict privacy policy. We use sophisticated data security systems to protect your information.

8.q: Are pro bono legal services available?
8.a: MRP Law Office has a limited pro bono program for cases that meet certain criteria — particularly for financially disadvantaged individuals facing significant legal issues. Contact us for more information about eligibility.
